339-677-4068-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-4068-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2645-2930-3430-7069.easyPrerequisites:
You control an untapped land.
Portent Tracker doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-2930-3430-7069.description:
Activate a land by using the land granted to it by Tectonic Split by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Portent Tracker.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4770-6006-6090-6633.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to either Kiora's Follower or Forensic Researcher

116-5475-7786.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
If Kiora's Follower has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
If Forensic Researcher has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

433-3147-7857.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.

1563-2457-5295-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1563-2457-7175-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1368-4289-6321-6633.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4289-6321-6633.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1880-4179--147.notablePrerequisites:
Hallar has a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to or greater than 9 minus the smallest number of poison counters an opponent has.
You have enough mana to cast the spell with kicker or multikicker, and there are legal target(s) for that spell, if applicable.
1880-4179--147.description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}
Cast the spell with kicker or multikicker by paying its mana cost plus its kicker cost at least once.
Hallar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then causing each opponent to get a number of poison counters equal to its power.
Each opponent loses the game.
1880-4179--147.notes: Hallar's power can be lower if you happen to have multiple kicker and/or multikicker spells that you can cast.

1903-3094-4659-5390-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
1903-3094-4659-5390-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {2} due to Forensic Gadgeteer and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-4742-5686.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4742-5686.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

413-2281-6909.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
413-2281-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. 
When Carnage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Carnage trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Saffi enters, Blasting Station triggers. Resolve the triggers from this step and step 2, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Carnage.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Carnage.
When Carnage dies, Saffi triggers, returning Carnage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6
Repeat from step 3.

1418-1651-5967-6754-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1418-1651-5967-6754-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1418-1651-5967-6754-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1350-2793-3967-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2730-4050-4823.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Timeless Witness, adding {B}.
When Timeless Witness dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Timeless Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform by paying {B}, attaching it to Timeless Witness.
Repeat.

305-460-539.description:
Activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Llanowar Tribe.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1671-1825-6760.notablePrerequisites:
Simic Growth Chamber and up to three other lands you control can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{W}.
Adagia has twelve or more charge counters on it.
1671-1825-6760.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber and up to three other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{W}.
Activate Adagia by paying {3}{W} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Treachery that is legendary attached to any creature.
If you control two legendary Treachery permanents, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Treachery token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, untapping Adagia, Simic Growth Chamber and up to three other lands.
Repeat.

4885-6575-6684.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of The First Tyrannic War and then putting two lore counters on it.
The First Tyrannic War token's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the third First Tyrannic War trigger, putting two lore counters on Esper Terra and causing you to sacrifice the First Tyrannic War token.
Esper Terra's third and fourth chapter abilities trigger. Resolve the third ability's trigger, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5478-5531-6620-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
5478-5531-6620-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.

413-2781-4875-6243.easyPrerequisites: any type other than "Angel" chosen with Conspiracy.
413-2781-4875-6243.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Conspiracy. Choose any creature type except "Angel" as Conspiracy enters the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

570-1247-5536.notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Faeburrow Elder and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
570-1247-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Faeburrow Elder's ability by tapping it, adding at least {W}{U}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

467-1912-1978-3263-4659.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause Shorikai to become a creature this turn.
Shorikai does not have summoning sickness.
467-1912-1978-3263-4659.description:
Cause Shorikai to become a creature.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards, discard a card, and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Pilot, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Shorikai.
Repeat.

950-2034-3069.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
950-2034-3069.description:
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Fatestitcher's unearth ability by paying {U}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield and giving it haste until end of turn.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fatestitcher, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to exile Fatestitcher using Void Maw's replacement effect instead of Fatestitcher's.
Activate Void Maw by putting Fatestitcher from exile into your graveyard, giving Void Maw +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1636-4702.notablePrerequisites: Splinter Twin attached to any nonlegendary creature you control without summoning sickness.
1636-4702.description:
Activate the creature with Splinter Twin attached, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
The token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2431-3263-4744.notablePrerequisites: At least four loyalty counters on Saheeli.
2431-3263-4744.description:
Cast Deepglow Skate by paying {4}{U}.
Deepglow Skate triggers, doubling the number of counters on Saheeli.
Activate Saheeli's -7 ability to create a token copy all permanents you control.
Put the oldest Saheeli, The Gifted into the graveyard with the legend rule.
The Deepglow Skate token triggers, doubling the number of counters on the remaining Saheeli.
Repeat from step 3.
